inventorySource.name: 2025 Federal Agency AI Use Case Inventory

frusFindings.headline: FRUS has four published production stages.
frusFindings.detail: History.state.gov describes the current FRUS flow as Planning, Research, Clearance, and Publication, with research explicitly covering archival research, selection, annotation, and review.

frusFindings.headline: Clearance is the biggest current bottleneck.
frusFindings.detail: The 2025 Report to Congress says declassification remains the single greatest obstacle to meeting the 30-year publication requirement; 46 volumes were in declassification review and 25 had been there for at least five years.

frusFindings.headline: FRUS is already moving toward incremental digital release.
frusFindings.detail: The 2025 report highlights a chapter-by-chapter publication approach so one uncleared chapter does not delay an entire volume, and the March 2025 HAC minutes note the first born-digital indexes across six volumes.

frusFindings.headline: HistoryAtState uses TEI, eXist-db, and XQuery as its digital publishing stack.
frusFindings.detail: The developer resources page states that article- and book-length content is encoded as TEI, stored in eXist-db, and converted into HTML and ebook forms with XQuery.

frusFindings.headline: The FRUS GitHub repo exposes canonical TEI sources and CI-generated publication artifacts.
frusFindings.detail: The FRUS repository explains that one TEI XML file represents a volume, document ids are canonical once released, tables of contents are generated automatically in CI, and releases are posted as soon as they are posted to history.state.gov.

frusFindings.headline: HistoryAtState runs a multi-repo build and deployment workflow.
frusFindings.detail: The hsg-project README describes history.state.gov as a multi-repository project built into eXist packages, while hsg-shell documents Node, Ant, Cypress, and automated release practices for the public website.

stageProfiles.title: Planning
stageProfiles.description: Grand conceptualization, volume conceptualization, backlog prioritization, release scheduling, and workload balancing.

stageProfiles.title: Research
stageProfiles.description: Collection, selection, annotation, and review of records across the national security establishment.

stageProfiles.title: Clearance
stageProfiles.description: Declassification coordination, redaction, sensitivity review, editing preparation, and release approvals.

stageProfiles.title: Publication
stageProfiles.description: Editing, indexing, metadata enhancement, chapter-based release, and public discovery on history.state.gov.

capabilityThemes.name: Semantic Search and Retrieval
capabilityThemes.description: Natural-language or semantic search over records, catalogs, or knowledge bases.

capabilityThemes.name: Metadata Enrichment and Tagging
capabilityThemes.description: Auto-generated descriptions, tags, entities, or structured metadata for records and datasets.

capabilityThemes.name: Summarization and Drafting Assistance
capabilityThemes.description: Draft summaries, notes, reports, or documents from complex inputs.

capabilityThemes.name: Transcription, OCR, and Translation
capabilityThemes.description: Speech-to-text, OCR, translation, or text extraction that reduces manual transcription labor.

capabilityThemes.name: Redaction and Clearance Triage
capabilityThemes.description: Find sensitive material, prioritize review, or automate redaction recommendations.

capabilityThemes.name: Publication and User Experience
capabilityThemes.description: Improve the public research experience with chat, recommendations, indexes, or discovery enhancements.

capabilityThemes.name: Planning Analytics and Workflow Routing
capabilityThemes.description: Trend analysis, prioritization, classification, or workflow support for managers and analysts.

recommendedPortfolio.name: Semantic FRUS Research Workbench
recommendedPortfolio.why: FRUS researchers need faster discovery across distributed archival corpora and prior FRUS volumes.
recommendedPortfolio.frusBenefit: Reduce time spent locating candidate documents, support series planning, and improve chapter-level release sequencing.

recommendedPortfolio.name: Annotation and Metadata Copilot
recommendedPortfolio.why: Annotation, glossary work, provenance notes, and digital descriptions are labor-intensive and repetitive.
recommendedPortfolio.frusBenefit: Accelerate drafts for notes, term lists, person lists, and descriptive metadata while keeping historians in the loop.

recommendedPortfolio.name: Clearance and Redaction Triage Assistant
recommendedPortfolio.why: The Report to Congress identifies interagency declassification and redaction review as the main delay.
recommendedPortfolio.frusBenefit: Rank risky passages, surface likely equities, and cut reviewer time spent on low-risk material.

recommendedPortfolio.name: Incremental Publication and Discovery Tooling
recommendedPortfolio.why: FRUS is already publishing cleared chapters incrementally and experimenting with born-digital indexes.
recommendedPortfolio.frusBenefit: Improve chapter release packaging, index generation, and public discovery without waiting for whole-volume completion.
